# Untrusted generated / sample artifacts

These files came from the supplied Meta bundle and are **not production evidence or trusted source data**.

They were removed from the production data path because inspection found synthetic or placeholder characteristics, including repeated fabricated-looking author/citation metadata, placeholder abstracts, and deterministic/repeated embedding patterns. Some records may reference real PMIDs, but the surrounding metadata was not independently provenance-verified.

Permitted use: regression fixtures and historical inspection only.

Forbidden use: loading into a production corpus, clinical knowledge base, vector index, analytics table, or as evidence that PubMed extraction/embedding succeeded.
